entities.summary: Maccabean, a notable figure in the history of Syria, associated with Hellenistic and Roman Syria (330 BCE–64 BCE). Preceded by Seleucid Empire. Their legacy influenced Antioch founded — becomes one of the four great cities of the ancient world and Roman Empire.
